facts.text: The Scarborough Subway Extension adds 7.8 kilometres to Line 2 from Kennedy Station to a new terminus at Sheppard Avenue East and McCowan Road.
facts.evidence: The Scarborough Subway Extension (SSE) extends Line 2 (Bloor-Danforth) by 7.8 kilometres from Kennedy Station to a new terminus at Sheppard Avenue East and McCowan Road.

facts.text: The subway extension includes three new stations at Lawrence Avenue and McCowan Road, Scarborough Centre, and Sheppard Avenue and McCowan Road.
facts.evidence: The SSE will run below grade and consists of three stations at Lawrence Avenue and McCowan Road, Scarborough Centre, and Sheppard Avenue and McCowan Road.

facts.text: Progress Campus in Scarborough is Centennial College's largest campus and is home to approximately half of its full-time students.
facts.evidence: Progress Campus in Scarborough is Centennial's largest campus. The Progress Campus is home to approximately half of Centennial's full-time student population.

facts.text: The University of Toronto Scarborough is the largest of the university's three campuses by land area.
facts.evidence: Scarborough is the smallest of the university's three campuses in terms of enrolment but the largest in terms of land area.

meta.descriptor: the eastern district of the City of Toronto and a former city
meta.fact: home to Centennial College's largest campus and the University of Toronto Scarborough

overview: Scarborough had about 623,605 residents in 2021, a population larger than most Canadian cities. It is a district of distinct neighbourhoods, from Agincourt in the north to Birch Cliff along the Bluffs, each with its own shopping streets and customer base.

For a local business, that scale cuts both ways. There is large demand, but customers have many choices nearby and across the rest of Toronto. The subway extension and two major post-secondary campuses add to the mix of commuters, students and families to reach.

byService.lead-generation: With roughly 623,605 residents, Scarborough lead generation works best when campaigns target specific neighbourhoods such as Agincourt or Malvern rather than the whole district.
byService.seo: SEO in Scarborough should combine district-wide terms with neighbourhood pages, because searchers often type Agincourt, Guildwood or Birch Cliff instead of Toronto.
byService.website-development: Scarborough serves students at Centennial and U of T Scarborough alongside long-time families, so a website must be fast on mobile and clear to many kinds of visitors.
byService.branding: In a district of more than 600,000 people, a brand that reflects its own neighbourhood and the communities it serves earns more loyalty than a generic Toronto identity.
